audit_item: A10 / recursively reject coerced scaler-manifest object keys
finding: `save_bundle()` serialized scaler and dataclass configuration dictionaries with `json.dumps`, which can coerce non-string mapping keys into JSON strings. Nested integer keys therefore changed identity during bundle freezing; mixed key types could also fail through an incidental sorting error instead of a stable validation boundary.
change: Recursively require string keys in scaler manifests and learner config dictionaries nested under lists/tuples, serialize with non-finite values disabled, and parse the generated scaler payload with the duplicate-key rejecting RouteB JSON reader before writing the bundle.

red_regressions: The root integer-key scaler case reached learner.checkpoint() on the old code instead of rejecting malformed input.
A nested learner-config integer key could be coerced while the final bundle manifest was written.
verification.isolated_routeb_jax_cpu_environment: tests/world_model/test_routeb_additive.py: 21 passed after both scaler and learner-config checks

boundary: Only synthetic malformed scaler manifests were tested; no model bundle, registry, market data, or formal evaluation data was loaded or written.
